### 2026-10-24 – ## Planning my MIDI keypad 🎹

**0.5h**

## Planning my MIDI keypad 🎹

This session I decided what instrument I'm building this week: an 8-button MIDI keypad that plays notes/drum sounds on my computer when you press the buttons.
I sketched *HEAVILY ROUGHED*

![WIN_20261024_22_41_30_Pro](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/avcd7VQ2s6IBdhwQ9OuJcFrKNgnjaZbd/0dba8fdebe37b178c9cb834602d7d9a25133b77fc6f4444ed07814c4679ecfd9.jpg)

the first layout on paper: a rectangular board with 8 round buttons in 2 rows of 4. I went with round buttons because they're easy to hit when playing beats.

**Next steps:**
- Pick the microcontroller (planning on a Raspberry Pi Pico)
- Add the Pico to the layout
- Start the schematic in KiCad
